# below are a list of issues with the autogenerated go sdk. 
- Tests
  - success responses are set to 200 and don't necessarily match the success responses of the route.
    - possible solution: I do not see any difference between success and bad responses in the openapi spec outside of the description.  Is there a field that needs to be updated here to get the sdk generator to pick it up?

- Models
  - We do not include a few fields in the swagger documentation and apply swaggerignore annotations in the restapi. This is because we don't want the api users to try and use those fields.  This means that those fields are also excluded in the sdk generation.
  - This not only impacts the functionality by not being able to read out swagger ignored fields from the body but impacts the model documentation as well. 
    - possible solution: do not use swaggerignore annotations in the rest api since this api will likely not be public facing (the sdk will)

- Call Funcs
  - The request creation functions do not have a paramater to include a model as an arg when the model needs to be included in the request body. Not sure why. 
    - possible solution: examine the openapi spec to see why the generator is not picking up the requestBody ref as part of the request creation...


## Ultimately, we can try and massage the openapi spec to make it work with the generator tool or we can simply make a cut and modify it to make it work.
